column1: # derivation: §9.4: LAG and LEAD read the row 1 before or after in the
# partition's order (g, ordered by id); where that row does not exist the
# result is the default, NULL when none is given. §9.5: every row counts,
# NULL or not. g = 1 (ids 1, 2, 3; v 10, NULL, 30): LAG is NULL (edge), 10,
# NULL (id 2's v); LEAD is NULL (id 2's v), 30, NULL (edge). g = 2 (ids 4, 5;
# v 40, 50): LAG NULL, 40; LEAD 50, NULL. g = 3 (id 6): both NULL (edges).
# Types: id, g, v keep their scanned types; each LAG/LEAD column is INT64
# (its values are cells of v, a default that is an INT64 literal (§8.19), or
# NULL) and nullable (§8: no row exempts it).
